newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH COALITION LEADERS SET NEW TALKS FOR TUESDAY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH COALITION LEADERS SET NEW TALKS FOR TUESDAY.

text.p: The leaders of the three parties in the Czech ruling coalition have scheduled another round of talks on the reconstruction of the cabinet for 6 p.m. (1600 GMT) on Tuesday, government spokesman Ivo Strejcek said.

Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said earlier on Tuesday that he would push for the rapid reconstruction of the cabinet in an attempt to end the political uncertainty which has hit the Czech crown hard in recent weeks.
Talks between the parties in the centre-right coalition ended inconclusively on Monday, two days after the finance, industry and trade, and interior ministers tendered their resignations.

The leaders agreed to change the cabinet last week in order to answer a sharp drop in the centre-right government's approval ratings amid an economic downturn and a widespread feeling that financial crime is pervasive.
But Monday's meeting suggested a final agreement on the share-out of ministerial posts would be difficult.
